purpose: Nineteen source-verified Clone Wars Force Power, Technique and Secret definitions, with explicit tier/defense gates, no implementation code.

sourceAuthority.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Clone Wars Campaign Guide.pdf

officialErrata.title: The Clone Wars Campaign Guide — Errata and Clarifications, updated January 2009
officialErrata.issuer: Wizards of the Coast RPG Team / compiled archive
officialErrata.priority: Official errata supersedes printing; p40 Focused Force Talisman amended. No p50-55 Force definition amendment confirmed in available errata excerpt.

mechanicalPrinciples.rollType: All eight Force Powers use UTF; four fixed DC ladder powers, four defense comparisons. Techniques and Secrets modify a qualifying power without a separate UTF check.
mechanicalPrinciples.tierSelection: Highest published tier at or below UTF total; defense checks compare total directly and never invent DC thresholds.
powerRecovery: Owned Force Power suite instances remain instance-based; techniques/secrets do not add power copies.
Focused Force Talisman errata recovers all spent copies of selected power on one eligible FP spend.
Linked Power reserves two power copies; second does not create a free permanent power.
mechanicalPrinciples.modifierApplication: Use typed influence graph keyed by published definition identity, not name or generic tags.
mechanicalPrinciples.errataPriority: January 2009 errata p40 Focused Force Talisman applies; p50-55 printed source unless a reliable official correction is found.

definitions.summary: Personal total concealment; increasing Stealth bonus on UTF fixed DC ladder.

dcTiers.summary: Total concealment until start of next turn
Total concealment; +2 Force Stealth bonus until start of next turn
Total concealment; +3 Force Stealth bonus until start of next turn
Total concealment; +5 Force Stealth bonus until start of next turn

resourceOptions.summary: Increase selected Stealth check bonus by +5 (does not grant concealment without successful base DC).

rulesNotes: A fresh UTF check selects the new tier each maintenance round; damage concentration DC15+damage.
Taking damage when maintaining may end cloak on failed concentration check.

definitions.summary: Personal vertical-only fly speed of 2, 4 or 6 squares; react to falling by spending 1 FP.

dcTiers.summary: Fly speed 2 squares, vertical-only (capped by no other source).
Fly speed 4 squares, vertical-only (capped by no other source).
Fly speed 6 squares, vertical-only (capped by no other source).

resourceOptions.summary: Reaction when falling: activate Levitate and reduce fall by selected tier fly speed.

rulesNotes: Special falling option spends **one** FP (not two); activation check still establishes vertical speed.
May step one square onto adjacent horizontal surface as a free action at end of movement.
Maintaining allows vertical movement; failed damage concentration immediately causes falling.

definitions.summary: Light Side: living target Fortitude; one CT step and temporary -5 damage threshold.

resourceOptions.summary: Replace the target DT penalty -5 with -10; do not stack penalties.

rulesNotes: Maintaining extends the damage-threshold penalty; no source authorization to repeat the -1 CT step.
Each maintenance check is UTF against the normal targeted Fortitude gate (review exact renewed failure handling).

maintenance.targetPersistence: Damage-threshold penalty only; no additional CT movement from maintaining Malacia.

definitions.summary: Grappled living creature Fortitude; per-round CT reduction, possibly trance or death at bottom.

requirements: Target must be living and currently grabbed or grappled.
Initial check must equal or exceed target Fortitude; printed maintenance clause uses STRICTLY exceeds Fortitude for additional CT step.

rulesNotes: If already unconscious, the target may be considered willing for Force trance.
Initial gate is at-least Fortitude; maintained subsequent gate is strictly greater than Fortitude.
Source says no maintenance on next turn if grapple ends; implement explicit lifecycle (current-round effect disposition is not redefined).

maintenance.targetPersistence: Target remains grabbed/grappled; escaping ends ability to maintain on following turn.

definitions.summary: Personal phasing speed 2/4/6/8 squares at DC 25/30/35/40; cannot exceed base speed.

dcTiers.summary: Phasing speed 2 squares, capped at base speed.
Phasing speed 4 squares, capped at base speed.
Phasing speed 6 squares, capped at base speed.
Phasing speed 8 squares, capped at base speed.

resourceOptions.summary: Increase phasing speed by two squares, still capped by base speed.

rulesNotes: The phase speed cap at normal base speed also applies after a Force Point increase.
May traverse hostile squares and solid obstacles, but cannot normally end a move inside occupied square (Improved Phase exception).
Maintain using move action and move up to speed; source does not explicitly require a fresh tier roll each round.

definitions.summary: Dark Side force tearing: UTF vs target Reflex; 3d6, natural 20 doubles, zero HP splits target.

resourceOptions.summary: After successfully hitting with Rend, deal +2d6 damage.

rulesNotes: Natural 20 on UTF explicitly doubles Rend damage, independent of ordinary attack critical rules.
Actual HP reduction to zero splits target; a living creature is killed automatically.
Force Point added dice interact with natural-20 critical multiplication; precedence is not expressly defined.

definitions.summary: Swift action: DC 25/30/35/40 reduces target DT against next hitting attack by 5/10/15/20.

dcTiers.summary: Next hit before encounter end treats target DT as 5 lower.
Next hit before encounter end treats target DT as 10 lower.
Next hit before encounter end treats target DT as 15 lower.
Next hit before encounter end treats target DT as 20 lower.

resourceOptions.summary: Ignore target DR on the attack benefitting from Shatterpoint.

rulesNotes: The source specifies the NEXT attack made before encounter end; a miss does not transfer the benefit to a later attack. Additional edge cases remain in editorial review.
No source rule to apply damage threshold reduction to every attack for the encounter.

definitions.summary: Touch droid/device; UTF versus Will to retrieve information or control droid; margin adds more facts.

choices.effect: Droid loses Dex bonus to Reflex versus caster next attack.
On next two turns droid only flees from caster at top speed.

requirements: Must touch one droid or electronic device.
Droid-specific alternate effects require droid target and a successful Will comparison.

resourceOptions.summary: Choose two additional information pieces OR extend one chosen droid-specific effect one round.

rulesNotes: One additional fact per complete 5-point success margin beyond Will; choose ONE of four result modes (information, jam, Dex-denial, flee).
FP extension applies to ONE selected droid effect, not all; FP extra knowledge adds two facts, not +2 to margin.

definitions.summary: Spend FP to link second Force Power to current round power; second fires free at start of next turn without alterations.

Deferred second Power goes off at start of next turn as free action.

resourceOptions.summary: Link two available powers; second activates free next turn; both cannot otherwise be modified.

rulesNotes: Linked Power Secret FP payment is distinct from prohibited FP modifications to either selected Power.
Two power uses are reserved; second has its own check at scheduled time (explicit execution design proposal; published wording does not discuss check timing).
Conflict with duration, no valid target at next turn, caster unavailable and off-turn incapacity require defined resolution.

unresolvedSourceInterpretations.issue: Linked Power delayed second power: roll and target-selection at next-turn-start proposed; printed rule states it goes off then but not how to handle interruption, invalid targets or source deletion.
Unconditional Power resource: Secret preface describes cost FP or DP as noted; entry itself provides no spend. Do not assume a cost or autocharge without decision.
Extend Power Charisma modifier zero or negative, and whether a nonstandard-maintenance power qualifies despite example standard-action conversion.
Shatterpoint refers to the next attack made before encounter end; design treats a miss as consuming the one-attack window. Verify expended unused power behavior alongside Core suite rules.
Morichro strict > on maintained check vs initial >=; delayed loss on broken grab, unconscious consent and kill/trance choice must be GM-visible.
Technometry FP extension: when droid forced flee for two turns, define whether +1 round means an additional turn of compelled flight vs extended state; keep source mode-specific.
Rend natural20 double damage plus optional +2d6 FP multiplication/ordering, no automatic reinterpretation as normal weapon crit.
Malacia maintenance new UTF vs Fortitude vs continuing only DT penalty; source states new UTF each round; preserve CT once unless source explicitly repeats.

Core feat/technique acquisition prerequisites: Clone Wars technique entries do not individually list base power as an acquisition prerequisite. Current packs add related-power fields; preserve effect relationship without treating it as published acquisition rule.
Published Source clone wars errata January 2009 p40 Focused Force Talisman: all spent copies recovered; no identified p50-55 Force Power correction in accessible published errata summary.
